# observability_query_client

Purpose: read-only Prometheus, Loki and Tempo clients over Dart HTTP's
HttpClientTransport, built on observability_wire (re-exported).

Read first:
- README.md
- lib/observability_query_client.dart

Main APIs:
- lib/src/source.dart (ObservabilitySource: base URL, credentials, transport, limits)
- lib/src/clients.dart (PrometheusClient, LokiClient, TempoClient)

Rules:
- Calls refuse redirects, cap response bytes, time out and redact URLs and credentials.
- Parsing and request building belong in observability_wire, not here.

Validation:
- dart analyze
- dart test
